title: </sub>  Bind precision evidence to the measured sweep version
text:
</sub>  Bind precision evidence to the measured sweep version

After the category list is revised, this gate can still be satisfied by precision evidence produced for the previous list: AC9 records target, model, fixture version, and sample count, but never the category-list version or equivalent sweep configuration. Once ten pull requests accumulate under the revised list, an operator could therefore publish a recall claim using stale precision results even though the new categories may introduce false positives. Require the precision evidence to use the same category-list version and effective sweep configuration as the real-PR comparison.
